title: Password Reset
content: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
allowed_actions: Employee can reset their own password via the self-service portal
escalation_rules: If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually

title: VPN Access
content: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
allowed_actions: Full-time employees receive VPN access automatically
escalation_rules: Contractor VPN access requires manager approval submitted via the access request form

title: Laptop Replacement
content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.
allowed_actions: Replacement can be requested after 3 years of service
Replacement can be requested earlier in case of verified hardware failure
escalation_rules: Replacement requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance

title: Software Installation Requests
content: Standard software listed in the approved catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
allowed_actions: Employees can self-install standard software listed in the approved catalog
escalation_rules: Non-catalog software requires IT Security review

title: Printer Troubleshooting
content: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.
escalation_rules: If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag

title: Email Mailbox Quota
content: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
allowed_actions: Employees nearing quota should archive old mail
escalation_rules: Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
content: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
allowed_actions: Any employee can generate guest Wi-Fi credentials from the front-desk kiosk

title: Expense Software Access
content: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists.
allowed_actions: IT can assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists
escalation_rules: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance

title: Security Incident Reporting
content: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.
allowed_actions: Report suspected phishing, malware, or unauthorized access immediately to Security
escalation_rules: Suspected phishing must be reported to Security
Suspected malware must be reported to Security
Suspected unauthorized access must be reported to Security

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days per week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance covering a chair or monitor. Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing. IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.
allowed_actions: Eligible employees may request the one-time home office equipment allowance
escalation_rules: IT handles equipment shipping only after approval

title: Asset Management Policy
content: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
escalation_rules: Early replacement outside the 4-year refresh cycle requires Finance sign-off
Early replacement also requires IT approval
